description: Trier für alle - Barrierefreiheit in der Stadt Trier - Steigungen der Straßen und Wege Trier is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Trier. Whether on the road in Trier or looking for barrier-free places, the city map Trier for all is intended to provide guidance for people with disabilities, senior citizens, parents with strollers or people with temporary mobility restrictions. Coverage: Stadt Trier. The portal shows the English title as "Trier for all - Accessibility in the city of Trier - Gradients of roads and paths Trier" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Trier. Its keywords include Höhe, inspireidentifiziert, Fußweg, infoMapAccessService, Wanderweg, Behinderter. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
